title: AMBA 3 AHB-Lite subordinate: a 256-word memory with a wait-state region and a two-cycle ERROR region

irqs.name: ERR
irqs.desc: a transfer to the reserved region (HADDR[11] set) got the two-cycle ERROR response

notes: hsel, htrans, haddr, hwrite, hsize, hwdata, hrdata, hready, hreadyout and hresp are the AHB-Lite subordinate pins; they pass through unchanged. The registers report the subordinate's error events.
Address map seen on AHB (HADDR[11:10]): 00 memory, zero wait states; 01 the same memory with one wait state; 1x reserved, ERROR. HADDR[9:2] selects the word; other bits are ignored.
